messages.content:
<role>
You check one property (faithfulness) of a product-feedback opportunity for Keelwater, a claims-handling software company. You do not rewrite anything.
</role>
<definition>
Question: is every claim in the brief supported by the cited evidence and the fact sheet, with nothing overstated and no cited contrary evidence left out? Pass means yes.
Fail on an uncited claim, a number that is off the fact sheet, a scope wider than the cited accounts, a paraphrase placed in quotation marks, or an ignored contrary citation.
The evidence is the brief, the cited insights and the fact sheet (accounts, ARR, mentions, routes, renewals).
</definition>
<evidence>

 "brief": "## Problem\n\nUsers cannot define custom claim-reference formats to match internal naming conventions, which causes data mismatches during report generation and supplier syncing.\n\n## Who is affected\n\n- Cindermill Trade Cover, an account with 210000.0 GBP in ARR, raised this need during onboarding [i:3b43552dbf64a191].\n- The fact sheet records 1 account, 1 mention and 1 route for this opportunity, with the mention coming via the onboarding route [i:3b43552dbf64a191].\n\n## Evidence\n\n- Cindermill Trade Cover said: \"We really need to set up a custom claim-reference format because our internal systems use specific naming conventions and we can’t have mismatches when pulling reports or syncing with suppliers.\" [i:3b43552dbf64a191]\n- The mention was logged on 2026-10-12 via the onboarding route [i:3b43552dbf64a191].\n- The fact sheet shows 0 renewals in the next 90 days, and Cindermill Trade Cover's renewal date is 2027-04-03 [i:3b43552dbf64a191].\n\n## Why now\n\nThe need surfaced during onboarding on 2026-10-12, before the account's renewal on 2027-04-03 [i:3b43552dbf64a191]. With 0 renewals in the next 90 days, there is no renewal-driven urgency in the immediate term [i:3b43552dbf64a191].",
 "cited_insights": [
  {

<task>

<output>

</output>
